note: Launch points for the atlas: one entry per system and place, not a count of the force. Bases are public; patrol areas are guesses; the loads and yields of the opaque arsenals are inferred, and Israel's is withheld. Warheads per missile are the deployed loads the Notebook gives (Trident at about four, Minuteman de-MIRVed to one, Yars four, Bulava six, Voevoda ten), not the missiles' capacities; a full-loading posture would roughly double the American and British figures.
